blocks.caption: Types
head: Type

blocks.text: Only the first five come from the Wild Life (Protection) Act. Biosphere reserves and Ramsar sites are international labels, not WPA categories.

remember: National park is stricter than sanctuary
Conservation and community reserves came in 2002
